title: Interior Designer
description:
Join our team at G cube studios, a leading interior design firm dedicated to creating stunning and functional spaces that inspire and delight our clients. With a focus on creativity, craftsmanship, and client collaboration, we transform residential and commercial interiors into personalized expressions of style and sophistication. If you're a talented and passionate interior designer looking to elevate your career in a dynamic and supportive environment, we invite you to join us on our journey of design excellence.

**Position Overview:**  
As an Interior Designer with our firm, you will have the opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects, from residential homes to commercial spaces, and collaborate with clients to bring their design visions to life. From concept development to project completion, you will play a pivotal role in every stage of the design process, leveraging your creativity, technical expertise, and industry knowledge to deliver exceptional results. This role offers the perfect blend of artistic expression, technical skill, and client interaction, allowing you to showcase your talent and make a meaningful impact on the spaces we create.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with clients to understand their design preferences, functional requirements, and budgetary constraints, and translate their vision into cohesive and aesthetically pleasing interior design concepts.
* Develop detailed design proposals, including floor plans, elevations, material selections, 2D Floor Plans and 3D renderings, to effectively communicate design intent and obtain client approval.
* Source and specify furniture, fixtures, finishes, and accessories that align with the design concept, budget, and project timeline, while considering quality, durability, and sustainability.
* Coordinate with architects, contractors, vendors, and other project stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of design plans and timely completion of projects.
* Conduct site visits to assess existing conditions, verify measurements, and oversee construction progress, addressing any design\-related issues or changes as needed.
* Provide design guidance and support to junior designers, interns, and other team members, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment.
* Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and new materials/products, and incorporate innovative design solutions into projects to enhance functionality and aesthetics.
* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with clients, industry partners, and vendors, and actively participate in networking events and professional organizations to expand our client base and promote our brand.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Proven experience in interior design roles, with a portfolio showcasing a range of residential and/or commercial projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, 3Ds Max or other design software, as well as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).
* Strong knowledge of design principles, space planning, building codes, and construction techniques, with the ability to translate conceptual ideas into practical and aesthetically pleasing designs.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts, listen to client feedback, and collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams.
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
* Creativity, innovation, and a passion for design excellence, with a commitment to staying abreast of industry trends and best practices.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
* Opportunities for professional development.
* Supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Team Outing \& etc.,

If you're a talented and motivated interior designer seeking a rewarding opportunity to showcase your creativity and contribute to impactful design projects, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your resume, cover letter, and portfolio highlighting your design expertise and relevant experience.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Preferred)
* Interior design: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Executive Graphic Designer
description:
**About Netafim:**


At Netafim, we work side by side with millions of farmers and communities around the world to address one of agriculture’s most pressing challenges: how to produce more food with fewer resources in an increasingly unpredictable environment. For more than 60 years, Netafim has been a global leader in precision irrigation, powered by people working across teams and geographies to bring together agronomy, engineering, data, and innovation.


Together, we help improve decision\-making in the field and drive better outcomes across crops and climates — turning complexity into clarity and making agriculture more precise, efficient, and sustainable to enable farmers to grow more with less.

**About Orbia:**


Orbia Advance Corporation is a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in the Polymer Solutions, Building \& Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura\-Line) and Fluor \& Energy Materials sectors. The five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on ensuring food and water security, expanding information access and connectivity, and advancing decarbonization and the energy transition with basic and advanced materials, specialty products, and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 22,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with a strong U.S. manufacturing presence and headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam, and Tel Aviv. The company generated $7\.6 billion in revenue in 2025\. To learn more, visit: orbia.com

**Key Responsibilities:**


Design social media creatives, brochures, posters, presentation templates, banners, and marketing collateral.


Edit and produce videos for product launches, training programs, webinars, events, and digital campaigns.


Create motion graphics, subtitles, and visual elements for videos.


Develop graphics for emailers, websites, WhatsApp campaigns, and internal communications.


Ensure all creative assets comply with Netafim brand guidelines.


Coordinate with marketing teams, agencies, and vendors for content creation and execution.

**Skills \& Qualifications**


Experience in graphic design and video editing.


Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects).


Knowledge of Canva and basic motion graphics.


Strong understanding of social media formats and digital content creation.


Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

**Preferred**


Basic photography and videography knowledge.


Familiarity with AI\-based creative tools.

**Requirements:**

* Graduate
* 2 to 3 years of experience in graphic design
* Experience in Agri\-input industry / rural marketing (preferred)
* **Location:** Bangalore – Work from Office / This profile May need travel
* **Language Proficiency:** English and Hindi are must. Any added languages are added advantage.

title: UX Designer
description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more about us at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: UX Designer  

Experience: 5 to 8 yrs.  

Job Location: Bangalore  

Position ID: J0926\-0532  

Work Type: Hybrid  

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  

Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

  

Role Overview  

We are looking for an experienced UX Designer to create intuitive, user centered experiences for web and mobile applications. The role involves working closely with product, business, technology, and client stakeholders from discovery through design and implementation.  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

. Conduct user research, stakeholder interviews, and discovery workshops.  

. Define personas, user journeys, workflows, and information architecture.  

. Create wireframes, prototypes, and interaction designs using Figma / Adobe XD / Sketch.  

. Conduct usability testing and incorporate user feedback into design iterations.  

. Ensure usability, accessibility, consistency, and responsive design.  

. Collaborate with Product Managers, BAs, Developers, UI Designers, and Architects.  

. Present designs and recommendations to stakeholders and clients.  

. Support Agile ceremonies and provide developer handoff specifications.  

  

Required Skills
  

. 5–8 years of UX Design experience for web/mobile applications.  

. Strong experience in UX Research, User Flows, Wireframing, Prototyping, Information Architecture, and Usability Testing.  

. Proficiency in Figma / Adobe XD / Sketch.  

. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.  

. Experience working in Agile environments.  

. Understanding of Design Thinking, Human Centered Design, and WCAG accessibility.  

  

Preferred
  

. Enterprise application / digital platform experience.  

. Familiarity with UI Design Systems and Component Libraries.  

. Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  

  

Mandatory Portfolio:
  

Candidates must provide a portfolio link with 2–3 UX case studies demonstrating the end to end process from research and user flows through wireframes, prototyping, testing, and final design.  

  

Key Deliverables  

Personas \| Journey Maps \| User Flows \| Information Architecture \| Wireframes \| Prototypes \| Usability Reports \| UX Recommendations \| Developer Handoff Assets
